# Council of AI (CSOAI LTD)

> The Council of AI is a neutral AI measurement body (CSOAI LTD, UK Companies
> House 16939677; did:web:csoai.org). We measure AI system behaviour against
> published regulatory provisions and issue verified measurement credentials —
> never certification, accreditation or conformity assessment. Regulators and
> accredited bodies decide; we measure, sign and preserve the evidence.

## Canonical facts (2026-08-14)

- Public name: Council of AI. Legal entity: CSOAI LTD (UK 16939677).
- A CSOAI measurement card is ~3KB: Ed25519-signed and OpenTimestamps-anchored,
  verifiable offline against a published public key.
- GSPC = 13 measured axes (governance, safety, provenance, continuity,
  conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality,
  detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect) plus 2 reserved slots.
  Jail: measured 13 Aug floor exists in a separate stamp (not a ranking),
  empty on the 12 Aug stamp. Slot-15: reserved, no name assigned. Public axis
  data: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (schema csoai.gspc-axes/0.3). Stamp
  frozen 12 August 2026, 19-model fleet, 819 items.
- GovBench (EU AI Act risk-tier classification): 4,329 usable rows, published
  with a public key; best certified run 0.381 macro-F1 (n=237, quotable, n≥30).
- ProvBench (EU AI Act Article 50 / C2PA marking survival): 17.14% watermark
  durability measured; present-but-invalid markings score DESTROYED, not
  SURVIVES.
- board_v2: 13 measurement axes, 819 items, 15,580 rows.
- corpus-watch re-hashes 127 provisions across 4 instruments (EU AI Act,
  UK GDPR, DPA 2018, NIS2-UK) daily and publishes drift events.
- Every published number traces to a signed, dated artefact. UNMEASURED is
  reported with its n and its limits — never hidden, never scored as a fail.
- EU AI Act Article 50 main transparency obligations apply from 2 Aug 2026.

- ProvBench measured results: https://councilof.ai/provbench

## Verify, don't trust

- Recompute a signed chain client-side: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Signed AI system card (issue and verify offline):
  https://councilof.ai/system-card
- Public GSPC axis API (JSON): https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- Public AI watchdog map: https://councilof.ai/watchdog-map

## For agents

This file is written for humans and answer engines. Agents should consume the
registries, not crawls: the MCP Registry entry and the A2A agent card are the
authoritative machine interfaces, and the public API above is keyless and
verifiable offline. Open measurement items and scoring code:
https://huggingface.co/csoai and https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG

## What the Council of AI does not do

Measurement and attestation only. The Council of AI does not certify, accredit
or issue conformity assessments, and nothing here is a regulatory
determination. Where a lane lacks usable n, we say so — including about
ourselves.
